 Yas Lions vs United Tigers Preview & Prediction | 2026 Abu Dhabi T10 | League Stage
 by Alex Sarwar · 9 November 2026 at 2:57 pm 
 Post 
 Share 
 Click here for today’s sports betting tips from our expert analysts! 
 Yas Lions are back at the Sheikh Zayed Cricket Stadium to face a powerful United Tigers outfit in Tuesday’s early Abu Dhabi T10 fixture. 
 Date & time: 
 10 November 2026 at 1:45 pm 
 Venue: Sheikh Zayed Cricket Stadium, Abu Dhabi, UAE
 Weather: Dry, hot and sunny conditions, with temperatures around 30c.
 How to watch: UK – ARY Plus & ARY Digital / USA – FloLive
 How to get tickets: Click here for the latest ticket information for Yas Lions vs United Tigers 
 Yas Lions vs United Tigers prediction 
 United Tigers have been one of the strongest batting sides in the competition so far. Fakhar Zaman and Joe Clarke have impressed at the top of the order, while the lower order is capable of scoring at breakneck speed.
 Yas Lions can match them at the top from a batting perspective, but their bowling still hasn’t totally convinced, and it would be no surprise to see them come undone against such a dangerous line-up.
 Whichever side bats first, we’re likely to see a high run chase. In the end, though, consider backing United Tigers to edge it.
 Yas Lions vs United Tigers tip: United Tigers to win
